Alisha (CEO): Heads-up — all-hands tomorrow 10:30am PT. Please skim agenda below and drop Qs here. Recording will be posted after. :calendar:

Ben (VP Eng): Plan: 40–45m total. Quick company pulse, Dedicated status, customer highlight, 3 lightning demos, ops/reliability brief, 15m Q&A.

Carmen (Product): Please prefix async questions with 'Q:' so we can compile. We'll surface top questions live and link the full list in the notes.

Dave (Ops): Note: Friday deploy window may shift depending on Q&A length — ops will coordinate.

Alisha (CEO): One-line agenda items:
- Company pulse (Alisha)
- Dedicated rollout update (Ben)
- Customer story: Raccoon Health (Carmen)
- Reliability & incident safeguards (Dave)
- Lightning demos (3 teams, 5m each)
- Live Q&A (15m)

Ben (VP Eng): Want to demo? DM me title + one slide by EOD. Focus on measurable impact (latency, cost, customer metric).

Allhands Bot: Calendar invite: https://company.calendar/meet/10-30-allhands — recording available ~1h after end.

Raj (Platform Eng): Q: Any changes to Dedicated rollout cadence?

Alisha (CEO): Raj — short answer: GA target still same, but we reprioritized zones for regulated customers. We'll explain more tomorrow.

Lina (Support): Q: Where will incident follow-ups live?

Dave (Ops): Lina — postmortems will be in #postmortems and linked from the all-hands notes. We'll redact customer specifics unless approved.

Marta (Sales): Q: Will there be a customer-facing pricing line for Dedicated we can use?

Carmen (Product): Marta — brief messaging will be given in the meeting; full collateral circulated afterward.

Alisha (CEO): Leaders: bring one win to celebrate and one quick ask you need help with. Short callouts only.

Ben (VP Eng): We'll mention a small default batching config change for new Dedicated clusters; ops will publish the config and rollout timeline after the call.

Dave (Ops): Config preview: default_batch_size: 64, default_max_latency_ms: 180, rolling_restart: true.

Carmen (Product): Drop Q: items here by EOD if you can't attend. We'll compile and publish the Q&A doc alongside the recording.

Alisha (CEO): Post-meeting we will publish: three wins, two ops asks, one product follow-up, recording link, and full Q&A. See you tomorrow! :sparkles:
